question: Which of the following dances is performed by the Santhal tribe of Jharkhand?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jhika Dasain.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jhika Dasain** is a** traditional dance form** of the** Santhal tribe of Jharkhand**.
 
• The dance is performed during the **Dasain festival,** which is celebrated in the **month of October.**
 
• The performers wear traditional **Santhal attire** and use various musical instruments such as **dhamsa, madal, and flute.**
 
• The dance is performed in a** group,** and the movements are **rhythmic and energetic**, with a lot of footwork and hand gestures. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kolkali** is a folk dance form of **Kerala,** which is performed with** sticks** by a** group of men** in a circular pattern.
 
• **Ghumar **is a folk dance form of **Rajasthan**, which is performed by **women in a circular pattern** while wearing colorful ghagras.
 
• **Koli** is a folk dance form of **Maharashtra, **which is performed by the** fisherfolk community** to celebrate their culture and lifestyle.
 
• **Santhal tribe **is one of the largest tribes in India, mainly found in the states of **Jharkhand, West Bengal, Odisha, and Bihar**.
 
 
• They have a **rich cultural heritage** and are known for their traditional **music, dance, and art forms**.
